title: Cobblemon: Zeitgeist
description: This modpack is designed to enhance your Cobblemon experience, adding a variety of extras and features to keep you engaged for hours.
body:
![Zeitgeist](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9ffe295d30c1691abb39a84b8883da8c545cbc8_0.webp)

Welcome to the official **Zeitgeist** modpack page on Modrinth!

Zeitgeist brings a fresh take to your Cobblemon experience, combining a wide variety of new content and mod elements into one cohesive package. The modpack focuses on a clean, minimal design without unnecessary clutter – clarity over chaos.

You start from nothing: no gifts, no shortcuts. Everything you need must be crafted, earned, and discovered on your own. A true survival experience built on depth, progression, and challenge.”

_Consider this Modpack being still in a BETA-Version. Expect bugs and visual glitches.
For optimal experience I recommend playing with at least 6GB of RAM._

# 🌍 Explore, Travel and Train 
New biomes await you both in the Overworld and deep within the caves! Discover a vast array of new structures and cities scattered across the world — including legendary monuments. But don’t be fooled by their abundance: structures remain rare. True exploration is richly rewarded, making every discovery feel meaningful and earned

# ⚔️ Battle to be a Champion 
Battle your way through countless trainers across the Overworld and within Pokémon Gyms! Earn badges, prove your strength, and rise through the ranks to become the ultimate Champion!

# 🛜 Multiplayer Compatibility
This modpack is fully multiplayer-ready and designed to be played with friends — or rivals. Team up, compete, and shape your journey together in a shared world of adventure and challenge.
# 
# 👑 Just the best of the best
This modpack features only Mega Evolutions and Z-Moves — no Gigantamax or Terastallization. Fakemon are also excluded for a more authentic experience.
On top of that, over 900+ Pokémon are included, expanding your journey with a diverse and carefully curated selection.

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5b659bb857fea27e8eb070960c8a4e79d56368a0.png)

- ✅ Based on Cobblemon 1.7.3 (latest version)
- 🐉 Over 900+ Pokemon available
- 🏛️ Exclusive Trainers / Gym-Leaders and their famous teams
- 🗼 Lots of Exclusive Structures filled with rare loot
- 🗺️ Integrated World-Map with fast travel options
- 🧰 Many storage options - say "no" to no capacity
- 💎 Earn XP by capturing wild Pokémon
- ⚔️ Encouter different Raids with high diffulty (playable as a team)
- 🎵 Custom Soundtrack to fit the Pokemon-Theme
- 🔧 Integrated EMI Support for Pokemon / Ore / Item locations
- ⚖️ Balanced gameplay and mods that were to strong / weak
- 🧈 Custom textures to enhance icons and atmosphere 
- 🌳 Hostile Mobs will spawn normally - it's still Minecraft
- 🧱 Pokémon-inspired furniture blocks (statues, floors, tables, etc.)
- 🍔 Lots of new food for you and your Pokemon
- 🗿 Easy and better Villagers
- ⚙️ Custom Mods only featured in this Modpack
- 🛠️ Performance boosts and lots of new QOL-Changes
- 💎 Quests are still WIP and will only be avaible on the CurseForge Version of this Modpack
